name: Sentry
description: Access Sentry issues, errors, projects and organizations via Sentry's official MCP server.

settings.label: Self-hosted host
settings.help: Optional, self-hosted Sentry only: hostname without scheme, e.g. sentry.example.com. Leave empty for sentry.io.

secrets.label: User auth token
secrets.help: Sentry → User Settings → Personal Tokens. Scopes: org:read, project:read, project:write, team:read, team:write, event:write
